title: Principles and Methodologies for Serial Performance Optimization
problem: Single-threaded/serial performance optimization requires different principles and methodologies than parallelization-focused optimization
motivation: Not all code can be parallelized; understanding serial performance optimization principles is important for extracting maximum performance from individual cores
method: The researchers systematically studied how to speed up code running on a single processor core, separate from parallelization (spreading work across multiple cores). For each optimization technique, they documented the underlying principle: what change actually causes the speedup and under what conditions it works best. They organized these findings into a coherent framework, showing how serial optimization principles differ from and operate independently of parallelization principles.
key_novelty: This paper documents and organizes all the principles governing single-threaded performance optimization in one unified framework.
contributions: Practical guidance for serial performance tuning
limitations: Title-only paper; specific principles and techniques not detailed; quantitative evaluation results not provided
